ROMANTIC_REJECTION.description: Explicit romantic rejection or broken engagement.

CHEATING.description: Explicit cheating wording; local negations excluded.

ABANDONMENT.description: Explicit being abandoned or kicked out.

STATUS_REVEAL.description: Explicit discovery of a status identity.

REGRESSION.description: Explicit temporal regression, not ordinary return.

REVENGE.description: Explicit revenge wording; not inferred from engagement.

REPLACEMENT_RELATIONSHIP.description: Explicit choosing/marrying a partner relative, or alternative romantic choice.

MARRIAGE.description: Explicit marriage wording; cancellation/negation excluded locally.

ESCAPE.description: Explicit escape/runaway wording, not generic leaving.

RETURN.description: Explicit returning wording; temporal regression handled separately.

WEALTH_REVEAL.description: Explicit wealth revelation, not a bare wealth role.

SYSTEM_ACTIVATION.description: Explicit system activation, not possession of a system.

THOUGHTS_EXPOSED.description: Explicit thought hearing/reading, not ordinary thinking.

ROMANTIC_BETRAYAL.description: Abstraction only when the partner-betrayal relation has direct evidence.

CLOSE_ASSOCIATE_INVOLVEMENT.description: Abstraction only for explicit partner choice of narrator close associate.

FAMILY_REGRET.description: Reserved: no automatic rule until familial subject can be resolved reliably.

OTHER.description: Reserved for manual extension; never forced as a default.

FIRST_PERSON_NARRATOR.description: First-person speaker reference; not independently verified protagonist.

FAMILY_MEMBER.description: Family role is mentioned; its narrative function is unresolved.

AUTHORITY_OR_STATUS.description: Status/authority word is mentioned; no event or ownership implied.

CLOSE_ASSOCIATE.description: Narrator close associate explicitly named relationally.

PARTNER_BETRAYS_PROTAGONIST.description: Partner explicitly cheats on narrator or leaves narrator for someone.

PARTNER_CHOOSES_CLOSE_ASSOCIATE.description: Partner explicitly cheats/leaves with narrator close associate.
PARTNER_CHOOSES_CLOSE_ASSOCIATE.pattern: \bmy (?:(?:CEO|heiress|billionaire|rich|sexy|boss|loyal) )?(?:wife|husband|fianc[eé]e?|girlfriend|boyfriend|GF|bride)\s+(?:cheated on me with|left me for)\s+my (?:best friend|brother|sister|cousin|childhood friend)\b

PROTAGONIST_CHOOSES_PARTNER_RELATIVE.description: Narrator explicitly chooses/marries a partner relative.

PROTAGONIST_ESCAPES_PARTNER.description: Narrator explicitly escapes a romantic partner.

notes: Patterns describe title wording, including proposed/quoted events; not verified story events.
Text order is not established story chronology.
Local negation guard is approximate; false negatives are preferred.
Unmatched roles/events remain empty; OTHER is not a fallback.
Overlapping labels listed in subsumes remain raw evidence but collapse to one abstract event; one wording span must not manufacture chronology.
